name: Grilled pork paste
summary: Grilled minced pork, sometimes wrapped on a lemongrass stalk, rolled in rice paper with herbs, green banana, and green mango. The 2021 price is one article. The price now is Check on arrival.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 lists nem nướng among the plates to eat in Buon Ma Thuot.
howToEat: The article says the paste is grilled until the edges char. Some shops wrap it around a lemongrass stalk. Roll it in rice paper with crisp fried sausage, fresh rice noodles, herbs, tart green banana, cucumber, and sour mango. The sauce is salty-sweet, thick, warm, and nutty from peanuts.
It prints 30,000–50,000 VND a portion and names Thanh Trầm, Thanh Loan, and Thanh Thủy. It does not print a street. The price now is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
where: Thanh Trầm, Thanh Loan, and Thanh Thủy. A street was not printed. The address is Check on arrival.
